name: dotfiles-dev-tools
description: Development formatting hooks (Go, Shell, Proto, OpenAPI), TDD agents, and skills incl. pi-implementer (a local model implements your Tickets through pi + pi-vcc) and second-opinion (Muse Code reviews your Diffs and Plans read-only; Claude verifies and argues back), consensus-review (security, cleanup and bug reviewers, then a blind Verifier per Finding; only medium+ Findings the Verifier confirms reach you), plus mods: Crawler Points HUD, Dispatch Board, Podman Guard, Branch Guard, TDD Band, Floor Boss, Sponsor Mail (PR watch), Beast Watch (GPU box health + Beast Guard) and the System's voice (its Cues are heard by dungeon-buddy)
